import json

import numpy as np

    setup=False,
    no_output=True,
    log=False,
)

    param_dict={

        "idx": "PQ_VERIFY_029_A",

        "q0": 0.006,
    },
)

threshold = 0.95

result_json["added_load_idx"] = "PQ_VERIFY_029_A"
result_json["added_load_bus"] = 4

result_json["selected_count"] = int(np.sum(below_mask))
result_json["min_bus"] = int(bus_ids[int(np.argmin(bus_v))])
result_json["min_voltage"] = round(float(bus_v[int(np.argmin(bus_v))]), 6)
